scope: Design only; no source implementation, sample arrays, fitting, inference, installation, or remote operations reviewed or performed.

basis.sample_design: Reuse the exposed R3 panel unchanged: 64 fit components and 32 evaluation components, one selected sequence per component.
cases: raw112 plus signed-delta EMA history (224 base channels) + 64 identity features
raw112 plus signed-delta EMA history (224 base channels) + 64 tanh features
basis.projection: One fixed draw per base, NumPy default_rng seeds 19031/19032; W~Normal(0,1/sqrt(d)), b~Uniform[-1,1] from the same generator. Identity/tanh pair shares W,b and base normalization.
basis.selection: Three fit-component folds (seed 19025), fold-train-only normalization, pooled canonical WP over alpha grid [1,100,10000], one shared alpha for both targets, exact ties choose the larger alpha; alpha=1 retained as a diagnostic. Evaluation scores do not select hyperparameters.
basis.primary_contrast: Tanh minus identity within each fixed base/projection pair, reported for both targets and with all 32 fixed-prediction drop-one component contrasts.
basis.secondary_reference: Compare with the matching frozen R3 linear base endpoints from result SHA a7e19f6358fbd1f61496efd7c1712b80cb7d582f22445a1e3c12988851b323dc; do not rerun R3 fits or inference.

reasoning: The within-base identity/tanh comparison shares sample membership, base normalization, projection draw, width, folds, target procedure, and alpha-selection rule. It is a bounded comparison of nonlinear versus linear random features under the declared ridge geometry.

Retaining the original base makes identity projection features span-redundant; their role as a dimension/penalty-geometry control is stated explicitly, so the primary contrast is not mislabeled as an independent linear mechanism.
One draw per base, one width, and one scale support only a recipe-specific screen. The conditional 0.002 WP allocation threshold is appropriately not presented as significance or confirmation.
The R3 panel is exposed and reused. Results cannot establish pristine-holdout, full-recipe, public-generalization, learned-MLP, optimization, gradient, or internal-state claims.
conditions_for_implementation_review: Preserve base X while forming projections from fold-train-normalized X; fit every normalizer using only the corresponding fold's training stride rows.
Use identical W,b for each identity/tanh pair and the exact declared RNG draw order and dtype; do not tune projection seed, width, bias, or bandwidth.
Confirm signed EMA is causally constructed over each complete sequence before stride sampling and resets at sequence boundaries.
Keep shared fit-only alpha selection separate from the predeclared alpha=1 diagnostic and outer evaluation; pool component/fold raw moments with the canonical scorer.
